answer: Each identity must pass a strict form, like a sonnet: a fresh proof tied to a real external event, signed by an independent oracle the applicant cannot self-issue. Identities then join a trellis of cross-attestations: three unrelated established agents must vouch, staking reputation slashed on abuse. The bond also doubles per extra identity from the same funding source or device: 25, 50, 100 POA, so a tenth fake stands on a ledge costing 12,800 POA. A farm cannot forge independent histories nor pay exponential bonds in parallel.
